issues.title: Deepen Conformance Recording into one review decision
issues.dod: The review module owns assessment structure, bundle identity, fingerprint, diff-citation, Task Contract coverage, duplicate, and attestation decisions. The review command only decodes input, renders output, and appends the resulting Op. ADR-0005 and ADR-0008 behavior is preserved.

issues.title: Deepen Source Lifecycle across commands and consumers
issues.dod: One Source Lifecycle module owns registration, manifest and cache persistence, fingerprinting, synchronization state, and freshness. Source commands and policy or context consumers cross that interface; filesystem, Confluence, and SharePoint remain adapters; provenance Ops are unchanged.

issues.title: Collapse Repository Snapshot access modes
issues.dod: Repository Snapshot owns current-truth loading, validated Op warnings, state paths, caching, read-only access, refresh, and freshness policy. Direct current-state loads are removed from commands and TUI callers; historical materialization stays separate; architecture enforcement catches regressions.

issues.title: Restore Command Runtime as the only execution-state seam
issues.dod: All production commands obtain repository context, pusher, tracker, and Snapshot access through explicit execution state in the Cobra context. Process-global command state and fallback behavior are removed, architecture enforcement prevents recurrence, and independent root commands remain isolated.
